hooks.name: Field measurements: real rows only
hooks.description: When a field-measurement CSV changes, check its columns and flag any row that looks invented.

action.prompt: A field-measurement CSV changed. Check that the header is exactly `date,tx_device,rx_device,environment,distance_m,payload_bytes,attempts,successes,notes`, that successes <= attempts on every row, and that payload_bytes is 1-140. Do not add, remove or 'fix' rows: these are real measurements typed in by a person. Report problems only. Then regenerate the device x environment table in README.md from the CSV.
